Fentanyl is an opiod agonist analgesic 81x more potent than morphine. 336.5 molecular weight.
Interacts predominantly with opiod mu-receptor.  These sites are located throughout brain, spinal cord & other tissues. Principal pharmacologic effect is on the CNS.
Elevates mood/euphoria/dysphoria.  Depresses respiratory centers, cough reflex & constricts pupils.
